item.tib: khrag 'thung rol pa bzlog pas ting 'dzin mtshon cha'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: dad ldan dbra btsun shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ bslab gsum yar ldan gyi bla ma rgyal mo rong gi rgyal rigs dge bshes rtsa ba'i rgyal mo rong gi rnal 'byor g.yung drung ye shes kyi (kyis) / shar khog sku bla g.yu dgon gyi mdun lung du/ bkra shis bsam 'grub sgar du sbyar ba'o//
